root_cause: Canonical owner-bound LinkedIn personal OAuth setup requested r_member_social alongside openid, profile, email and w_member_social. LinkedIn documents r_member_social as closed. User's screenshot of canonical Composio redirect displayed unauthorized_scope_error, consistent with a missing/unsupported scope. Individual rejected scope not disclosed in screenshot, so new auth still needs provider readback.
prevention: Use only exact least-privilege approved member OAuth scopes openid/profile/email/w_member_social for the same canonical publisher and owner; never reuse historical Composio auth configs containing extra r_member_social or organization scopes; verify actual provider grant. Preserve real provider-ID+independent readback and no-repost claims without copying tokens or creating alternate publisher. Do not mark channel LIVE without provider side effect and independent verification.

evidence.source: 2026-10-29 user screenshot of canonical Composio/LinkedIn OAuth callback plus production setup source
